discount_offers.name: GPT-5.6 Sol
registration_conditions: The promotion is available for Unified Billing users only (not Bring Your Own Keys). Load credits onto AI Gateway and start sending requests to openai/gpt-5.6-sol.
To use Unified Billing, you must purchase and load credits into your Cloudflare account in the Cloudflare dashboard, which you can then spend with AI Gateway.
A 5% fee is applied to all credits purchased through Unified Billing. For example, a $100 credit purchase will result in a $105 charge.
Ensure your Cloudflare account has sufficient credits loaded.
Ensure you have authenticated your AI Gateway.
To use credits for Workers AI, set your gateway's Workers AI Billing setting to Unified billing.
